messages.subject: Loglikelihood and Information Criteria return "NA"
parts:
Hi,

I use Lavaan 6.6 to built a SEM. I did not get any error message and all others indices are OK;  but the "Loglikelihood user model (H0)" and "Loglikelihood unrestricted model (H1)" are not computed. So AIC and BIC return NA. For missing values, i used the option missing="FIML.x" to allow missing values in my observed indicators. Are my results valid?

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Loglikelihood and Information Criteria return "NA"
parts:
On 7/23/20 4:21 PM, Abdoulaye Ouattara wrote:
> I use Lavaan 6.6 to built a SEM. I did not get any error message and all
> others indices are OK;  but the "Loglikelihood user model (H0)" and
> "Loglikelihood unrestricted model (H1)" are not computed. So AIC and BIC
> return NA. For missing values, i used the option missing="FIML.x" to
> allow missing values in my observed indicators. Are my results valid?

Are you using categorical data? Then this is normal, as the default DWLS
estimator has no likelihood.

If you are using continuous data + ML, this should not happen. In that
case, please send me a reproducible example (script + data), or open an
github issue.

Yves.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Loglikelihood and Information Criteria return "NA"
parts:
The issue turns out to be missing = "fiml.x", in combination with the
(default) fixed.x = TRUE. This combination leads to NA values for the
loglikelihood.

The quick fix is to either set fixed.x = FALSE, or missing = "fiml".

Yves.
